Business Analyst Intern

Company: Pemberton Health Systems
Location: London, ON
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Fall 2027
Duration: September to April
Salary: $26.50 per hour
Application Deadline: 2027-06-11

About the Role

Pemberton Health Systems supports regional hospitals with clinical scheduling software.
The Business Analyst Intern will support requirements gathering across two product teams.

Responsibilities

- Document business requirements and user stories
- Support process mapping workshops with clinical staff
- Perform gap analysis between current and future state workflows

This is an eight month work term running from September 2027 to April 2028.
